brief.headline: Jio Platforms shares surge 21% in Mumbai debut
brief.detail: Jio Platforms shares jumped 21% on their Mumbai trading debut following a $3 billion India IPO.

brief.headline: Fed holds rates steady as expected, two officials want a hike
brief.detail: The Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged as expected, though two policymakers preferred a 25 basis point hike.

brief.headline: Oracle stock pops 12% on long-term revenue forecast
brief.detail: Oracle forecast fiscal 2030 revenue of $225 billion and said it will limit fundraising over that stretch to $20 billion, easing debt concerns.

brief.headline: Wendy's receives $1.4 billion take-private offer from Peltz-led group
brief.detail: Trian Fund Management's Nelson Peltz offered $1.4 billion for Wendy's, which says it requires significant capital investment to get back on track.

brief.headline: Coca-Cola raises guidance again, but investors sell the beat
brief.detail: Coca-Cola raised its guidance again, yet investors sold the stock despite the earnings beat.
